reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in the #central-team thread. I logged the Bay 24 tip as unverified and said I can't confirm or rule it out: nothing he has access to mentions an Osprey rollout at Quarrendon Freight Lines or Bay 24.

I also pointed out that Quarrendon Freight Lines is a North team account, owned by Dana Okafor according to the public notes. Dana or the North team lead, Ilse Varga, would need to confirm it before anyone acts on it.

I only checked the knowledge base and the public notes he could see himself. I didn't read any North team or incident channels, because he isn't a member of them.
